lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué pasa? Riddle: what has—ooh, a leaf. Just one more lap, then introductions. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Hi! What's up? Riddle: what has—ooh, a leaf. Just one more lap, then introductions. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with no apparent deadline. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; looking directly at him proves unhelpful.

lines.native: ¡Sí, miro! Pero sigo corriendo. Looking isn't stopping! Riddle: how do you stop a—ooh, another leaf. Your attention: ten out of ten. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, I'm looking! But I'm still running. Looking isn't stopping! Riddle: how do you stop a—ooh, another leaf. Your attention: ten out of ten. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick looks at the leaf without slowing down. This is compliance of the least useful kind.

lines.native: ¡Vale, no me muevo! Stopping: accomplished. Exhausting. ¿Por dónde voy? Riddle: what moves without—wait, is that leaf following me? Estoy perdido. Five more minutes? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Okay, I'm not moving! Stopping: accomplished. Exhausting. Which way do I go? Riddle: what moves without—wait, is that leaf following me? I'm lost. Five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker completes the paperwork.

lines.native: ¿Por dónde voy? En español, por favor. English directions? My feet don't have that subscription. Riddle: what walks without—ooh, smoke. ¡Estoy perdido! ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Which way do I go? In Spanish, please. English directions? My feet don't have that subscription. Riddle: what walks without—ooh, smoke. I'm lost! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, awaiting directions in a language it cannot pretend to misunderstand.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! ¿Qué hora es? El reloj no funciona. Riddle: what has hands but—ooh, yours! Five more minutes? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! What time is it? The clock doesn't work. Riddle: what has hands but—ooh, yours! Five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left and vanishes into the corner of your vision. A tiny firecracker draws your attention to the fountain’s stopped clock, which has avoided responsibility for years.

lines.native: ¿Me preguntas a mí? ¡No sé! El reloj no funciona. That was a question—tell me the time instead. Riddle: what has—ooh, smoke. ¿Qué hora es? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Are you asking me? I don't know! The clock doesn't work. That was a question—tell me the time instead. Riddle: what has—ooh, smoke. What time is it? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick appears elsewhere, having delegated punctuality to the explosion.

lines.native: ¡Sí, son las tres y media! Muy bien. Pero podemos esperar. ¿Por qué tanta prisa? Riddle: what waits for—ooh, sparks. Just five more minutes. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, it's half past three! Very good. But we can wait. Why such a hurry? Riddle: what waits for—ooh, sparks. Just five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is elsewhere, as usual, supervising the delay.

lines.native: ¡Mañana, sí! Eso es esperar. Estoy muy contento. Your urgency: zero stars. ¿Quieres esperar? ¿No? ¿Cuándo, entonces? Riddle: what waits—ooh, sparks. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Tomorrow, yes! That means waiting. I'm very happy. Your urgency: zero stars. Do you want to wait? No? When, then? Riddle: what waits—ooh, sparks. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains just outside your gaze, where responsibility cannot establish eye contact.

lines.native: ¡Ahora, sí! Entiendo. No quieres esperar. Está bien, puedes pasar. Yo voy después. Riddle: what ends before—ooh, freedom. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Now, yes! I understand. You don't want to wait. All right, you can pass. I'll go later. Riddle: what ends before—ooh, freedom. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. The gate opens; Flick credits the hinges with excessive ambition.
